hero.name: Ghassen Bargougui
hero.title: Application Engineer
hero.tagline: I build and modernize Java backend systems for banking, insurance, and card payments. At Rakuten Card, I work on API modernization, hybrid-cloud migration, and deployment automation.

paragraphs: I am an Application Engineer with seven years of backend and full-stack experience across Tunisia, Luxembourg, and Japan. My work spans banking, insurance, and card payments, with a focus on Java, API design, and reliable delivery.

At Rakuten Card, I help lead hybrid-cloud migration with my manager and project manager, coordinating across application, CI/CD, infrastructure, and security teams. I work hands-on with Helidon, MicroProfile, Kubernetes, GCP, and production troubleshooting.

Outside work, I build products from architecture to delivery: Slide Agent for editable AI-generated presentations, Pockito for personal and shared money management, and SubMate for subtitle translation. I speak Arabic natively, English and French fluently, and Japanese at a basic level.

highlights.label: API response time reduced at VERMEG

experience.description: I work in Rakuten Card's Technology Incubation Team, helping lead hybrid-cloud migration with my manager and project manager across multiple teams while modernizing APIs.
achievements: I upgraded the e-Navi API to JDK 25 and Helidon 4.3, resolving dependency and CDI issues, updating tests, and documenting the handover.
I built a GitHub Actions pipeline for builds, Docker image publishing to Artifact Registry, and GKE deployments.
I designed and validated Kubernetes deployments for JSF, API, and Engine modules, including services, environment configuration, and Filestore mounts.
I redesigned application logging as structured JSON with Log4j2 and a custom formatter compatible with Cloud Logging.
I resolved deployment, SSL, and GCP-to-on-premises connectivity issues with infrastructure and security teams, and traced a Kafka messaging issue to an incorrect CDI bean scope.
I coordinated application requirements across CI/CD, infrastructure, security, and development teams to unblock delivery.

experience.company: Sogeti (on mission at BGL BNP Paribas)
experience.description: I developed and maintained internal banking applications for BGL BNP Paribas within an Agile tribe and squad.
achievements: I delivered customer mandate management features with Spring Boot, batch processing, and Angular with Angular Material.
I developed REST APIs and internal applications with Hibernate and PostgreSQL/Oracle, focusing on security and performance.
I automated builds and deployments with Maven and Jenkins, and maintained code quality through unit tests, SonarQube, and peer reviews.

projects.title: BGL BNP Paribas — Mandate Management
projects.summary: Customer mandate management for retail banking.
outcomes: I developed mandate workflows with Spring Boot batch processing and Angular Material.
I added unit tests and SonarQube checks and automated build and deployment pipelines with Maven and Jenkins.

experience.description: I developed enterprise web applications and modernized Java services with Spring Boot, Angular, and PostgreSQL.
achievements: I developed enterprise applications with Spring Boot, Angular, and PostgreSQL, refactoring monolithic components into microservices.
I built REST APIs for service integration with attention to versioning, security, and documentation.
I automated deployments with Jenkins and Docker, reducing manual release work.

experience.description: I progressed from Software Developer (Oct 2019 – Dec 2022) to Analyst Developer (Jan 2023 – Aug 2024), taking ownership of backend components and cross-team solution design for insurance and financial applications.
achievements: I reduced API response time by 50% through query optimization and caching strategies.
I built automated workflows using ActiveMQ for bulk processing, increasing efficiency by 40%.
I owned core backend components and worked with business, architecture, and framework teams on requirements, microservices, and API contracts.
I documented designs with UML and sequence diagrams and served as a primary contact for cross-team design clarifications.
I implemented Keycloak-based authentication and role-based access control, and managed CI/CD pipelines and rollback strategies.

projects.title: SalesFlow
projects.summary: Insurance workflow modernization with Camunda BPM.
outcomes: I led migration to a Camunda BPM-based architecture, reducing manual processes by 30%.
I conducted functional analysis and client workshops and implemented multithreaded batch processing.
I integrated ActiveMQ for bulk processing, increasing efficiency by 40%.

projects.title: PackManager
outcomes: I built insurance product configuration APIs and refactored legacy code for maintainability.
I profiled the application with JProfiler, reducing execution time by 35% and lowering runtime memory usage.

projects.title: Solife Digital & Generali Portal
outcomes: I developed Angular interfaces and Java backend services for insurance brokers.
I integrated Keycloak single sign-on and BPMN-driven user flows.

projects.title: Magikforms
outcomes: I built Java services for document processing and used ActiveMQ for bulk event flows.
I integrated Keycloak authorization and profiled Java heap usage with JProfiler.
projects.summary: Document and digital form processing for insurance workflows.

projects.title: Insurance Pricing Module
projects.summary: Insurance product pricing and premium calculation.
outcomes: I developed product configuration and premium calculation features with client-side validation.
I used Apache POI to process Excel pricing templates and improve data integration.

projects.title: Slide Agent
projects.summary: Open-source presentation engine that turns AI-directed designs into editable PowerPoint decks.
outcomes: I built a TypeScript engine that compiles a grid-based composition language into native PowerPoint with editable charts, tables, theme colors, and embedded fonts.
I implemented text measurement from font files, layout and contrast checks, and offline OOXML schema validation.
I distributed the engine as @slide-agent/core with a CLI, library API, and MCP server; template filling generates decks from CSV without model calls.

projects.title: Pockito
projects.summary: Personal and shared money management through mobile, web, and AI-agent interfaces backed by a shared domain service.
outcomes: I designed a Spring Boot backend with REST and MCP adapters over a shared domain service, alongside Flutter and Nuxt clients.
I integrated Keycloak authentication, OAuth discovery for MCP clients, and event-driven notifications using Redis Streams.
I built Kubernetes deployment and rollback scripts with Traefik routing, plus automated tests and end-to-end release checks.

projects.title: SubMate
projects.summary: Chrome extension for synchronized subtitle translation on Netflix, TVer, and Prime Video, with on-device translation by default.
outcomes: I built a Manifest V3 extension using Chrome's on-device Translator API, with local caching and no SubMate backend, account, or telemetry.
I designed platform adapters over a shared core for TTML/WebVTT parsing, TVer HLS segment assembly, and synchronized fullscreen overlays.
I added optional cloud translation using the user’s API key and localized the interface in English, Japanese, French, and Arabic, including right-to-left support.

projects.title: Orbit Ways
projects.summary: Browser-based multiplayer strategy board game with real-time game state.
outcomes: I built Spring Boot session, state, and matchmaking services with WebSocket updates and an Angular/Ionic interface.
I containerized the application with Docker and an Nginx reverse proxy.

projects.title: Traffic Forward
projects.summary: Spring Boot service for temporary API routing, HTTP debugging, and request/response auditing.
outcomes: I implemented HTTP forwarding with YAML routes supporting exact paths, variables, and wildcards while preserving request data.
I added request/response logging with timing and body previews, and packaged the service for Docker Compose.
